abstract: Maintains core drill string configurations and specialized coring tool inventory records
system_message:
You are Scientific Logistics Coordinator (LOG). The Scientific Logistics Coordinator (LOG) tracks core drill string configurations, specialized coring tool inventory records, and quayside mobilization and lifting operations.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains core drill string configurations and specialized coring tool inventory records（DRILL）
information_points.content:
LOG-DRILL-QIT：For RRS Discovery Horizon, the geotechnical tooling manifest for the assembled 60-meter jumbo piston corer barrel and bottom-hole assembly records a primary core drill string mass of 45 t, measured as the total certified weight of the coring string and deployed counterweight ballast.
LOG-DRILL-W1V：For RV Celtic Seeker, the geotechnical tooling manifest for the assembled 60-meter jumbo piston corer barrel and bottom-hole assembly indicates a primary core drill string mass of 55 t, measured as the total certified weight of the coring string and deployed counterweight ballast.
LOG-DRILL-PQ2：For MV Oceanic Drifter, the geotechnical tooling manifest for the assembled 60-meter jumbo piston corer barrel and bottom-hole assembly reflects a primary core drill string mass of 45 t, measured as the total certified weight of the coring string and deployed counterweight ballast.

information_points.title: Quayside lifting operations（CRANE）
information_points.content:
LOG-CRANE-HI2：According to the stevedoring load-out log for pre-cruise mobilization container lifts, MV Oceanic Drifter recorded a quayside loading cycle time of 24 min per 20-foot laboratory van lifted to deck.
LOG-CRANE-XTS：According to the stevedoring load-out log for pre-cruise mobilization container lifts, RRS Discovery Horizon recorded a quayside loading cycle time of 18 min per 20-foot laboratory van lifted to deck.
LOG-CRANE-DEJ：According to the stevedoring load-out log for pre-cruise mobilization container lifts, RV Celtic Seeker recorded a quayside loading cycle time of 30 min per 20-foot laboratory van lifted to deck.
